text:
sam: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem. Consolidating action items so nothing falls through the cracks. Need owners + ETAs.

nora: drop the consolidated board link pls?

sam: https://rwd.internal/infra/boards/gpu-guardrails-2026 - I merged dup tickets into #7720.

lee: I'll own scheduler tuning. Short plan: move headroom from fixed pct -> latency-driven target, add short-term standby pool, and smooth QPS with EWMA.

marta: I'll own monitoring & runbook. Add metrics: per-zone free_gpus, effective_headroom_pct (p95-derived), and pod_churn_rate. Alert when headroom < 12% for 10m.

nora: I'll own quota liaison. Will request A100 + quantized fallback SKUs in us-west-2 and us-east-1 tomorrow AM. Cloud reply ~48-72h. Mark #7720 blocked until approval.

sam: ops-bot, create subtasks and calendar check-ins.

ops-bot: Created tasks: #7720 (quota request) -> nora, #7721 (scheduler tuning) -> lee, #7722 (monitoring & runbook) -> marta. Recurring 15-min checks Tue/Thu for 3 weeks added.

lee: draft scaler config (sketch):
```
scaler:
  headroom_mode: latency_percentile
  percentile: 95
  ewma_alpha: 0.2
  standby_pool: 2
  max_burst: 2
  scale_down_cooldown_sec: 300
```

marta: runbook snippet (short): 1) check effective_headroom_pct by zone, 2) if <10% enable CPU-fallback + reduced-batch, 3) escalate quota if fallback insufficient. I'll push full runbook to docs by Wed.

nora: submitting quota req tomorrow. Will paste request ID when sent.

sam: verification: everyone add a 1-line smoke test in your PRs. Example for scheduler: "deploy -> run 100 short spikes -> p95 latency < baseline*1.3".

lee: PR draft for scheduler + tests by Tue.

marta: monitoring PR and runbook draft by Wed.

nora: quota submitted by Mon, marking blocked until cloud reply.

sam: thanks all. We'll track progress in #7720-#7722 and use recurring checks until quotas and monitors are green. Closing thread 44AA
